Hi all — quick diagnostic from Support. Reproduced locally with the attached HAR and the HTML snippet. Observations:

- The invite URL includes a fragment token ("#t=...") rather than a query param. Fragments are client-side only and are not sent to the server during an HTTP request.
- The Coupa flow uses a multi-step redirect (Coupa -> our IdP -> Coupa). During the IdP roundtrip a Set-Cookie for the Coupa session is issued with Path=/app and SameSite=Lax.
- On the final return the browser performs a navigation to an anchor/fragment URL which appears to clear or reload a different document scope; in some browser + extension combinations the session cookie is not applied to the reloaded resource because the final URL path differs (cookie path mismatch + fragment anchor).
- We also saw an edge-case where a client-side router (single-page-app) intercepts the fragment and the request sent to Coupa lacks the CSRF/session token expected, resulting in a 403.

Temporary mitigation steps (doable by customer right away):
- Open the invite link in a fresh private/incognito window (ensures no stale cookies).
- If that succeeds, ask users to clear cookies for coupa.com and retry.
- As a deterministic workaround, replace the fragment token with a query param copy (e.g., ?t=...) and re-send the invite. The server will receive the token and won't depend on fragment handling.

What we need from Coupa (we can open the ticket):
- Server-side normalization of invite tokens (accept both fragment and query variants) OR ensure the Set-Cookie path and SameSite attributes survive the IdP roundtrip.
- Coupa auth trace around the failing request (request id/time). Sophie — if you can forward the coupa response headers or the trace, Ben can attach it to the ticket.

I've attached an anonymized auth trace we captured (coupa_auth_trace.log) and a short reproduction note. Camila — can you validate the SPA fragment-handling hypothesis against any custom Coupa integrations Orchid might have?

—Ben Carter
Platform Support Engineer, Redwood Inference
